findings.message: Possibly? I recommend that this starts much larger, around 64KiB. 4096B is much too small, even for tiny embedded systems. We can correct it in a later change if it needs to be corrected.
findings.tp_fp_justification: workingjubilee (reply, thread root 1687015062): PTHREAD_STACK_MIN (4096 bytes) is far too small for the spawned thread's stack compared to the previous 256KiB, risking stack overflow.
